derivation: from H7783 (שׁוּק) in the original sense of stretching out after;

words.word: and unto thee shall be his desire

occurrences.text: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
words: And unto thee shall be his desire
